Class 13 — The Movies

WHAT YOU WATCH

2🎬 Lee

3🎬 Lee
공포 영화는 별로 안 끌려요.

🔁 같은 패턴으로: I'm not really into golf. · I'm not really into spicy food.

4🎬 Lee
어쩌다 한 주말에 두 번이나 보게 됐어요.

🔁 같은 패턴으로: I ended up staying late. · I ended up buying two.
🐢 느리게
🚀 보통 속도
5🎬 Lee
그거 몇 달째 보려고 벼르고 있었어요.
I've been meaning to watch that one for months.
🔁 같은 패턴으로: I've been meaning to call him. · I've been meaning to fix that.
🐢 느리게
🚀 보통 속도
6🎬 Lee
이건 셀 수 없이 많이 봤어요.
This one, I've seen more times than I can count.
🔁 같은 패턴으로: I've been there more times than I can count.
🐢 느리게
🚀 보통 속도
TALKING ABOUT ONE
7👤 Friend
무슨 내용인데요?
What's it about?
🐢 느리게
🚀 보통 속도
8🎬 Lee
모든 걸 잃고 다시 시작하는 남자 얘기예요.
It's about a guy who loses everything and starts over.
🔁 같은 패턴으로: It's about a woman who ~ · It's about a team that ~
🐢 느리게
🚀 보통 속도
9🎬 Lee
제가 좋아하는 건 음악이에요.
What I like about it is the music.
🔁 같은 패턴으로: What I like about this gym is the hours. · What I like about my job is the people.
🐢 느리게
🚀 보통 속도
10🎬 Lee
결말이 확 오더라고요 — 전혀 예상 못 했어요.
The ending really got me — I didn't see it coming.
🔁 같은 패턴으로: That scene really got me. · His speech really got me.
🐢 느리게
🚀 보통 속도
11🎬 Lee
좀 느린데, 볼 만해요.
It's a bit slow, but it's worth it.
🔁 같은 패턴으로: It's a bit expensive, but it lasts. · It's a bit far, but it's quiet.
🐢 느리게
🚀 보통 속도
12🎬 Lee
실화 좋아하면 좋아할 거예요.
You'd like it if you like true stories.
🔁 같은 패턴으로: You'd like it if you like spicy food.
🐢 느리게
🚀 보통 속도
